title: Hazel and the Winter
author: Edmund Vasquez
blurb: Odile Pemberton, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
